narr: A complex of severe thunderstorms moved southeast across southwest Indiana, producing locally damaging winds and pockets of flash flooding. The complex of storms initiated along a stationary front draped from west to east across central Illinois and central Indiana. The storms moved into a very moist and unstable air mass across the lower Ohio Valley, with mixed-layer cape values from 1500 to 2500 J/kg. Thunderstorms reformed along and ahead of the front, resulting in training of southeast-moving storms across parts of southwest Indiana.
ev: Numerous main roads were closed around Boonville. Cars stalled due to flash flooding.
